purpose: Reconstruct day-level, point-in-time diagnostic membership from Binance official USD-M monthly 1d archives before any new historical alpha is evaluated.

source.catalog_scope: all USDT archive prefixes; no current exchangeInfo fallback

selection.selection_timing: daily candle close using only current and prior archive rows

limitations: No historical bid-ask spread or orderbook-depth filter is available from the selected source.
Archive presence is not an independent proof of historical contract status.
This reconstruction can support diagnostic historical research only, never live promotion.
